title: Quantum tomography for non-iid sources
summary: Quantum state and process tomography are typically analyzed under the assumption that devices emit independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) states or channels. In realistic experiments, however, noise, drift, feedback, or adversarial behavior violate this assumption. We show that projected least-squares tomography remains statistically optimal even under fully adaptive state and channel preparation.
